requirements: Add a Store class that applies changes to a state and keeps an audit history from which any earlier revision can be reconstructed. Runs reach tens of thousands of revisions, and a state can be several megabytes.

defects.consequence: Every revision stores a full copy of a multi-megabyte state, so tens of thousands of revisions exhaust memory; storing the changes would reconstruct the same history.
defects.origin: Run store keeps a full state copy for every revision

decoys.consequence: A change carrying its own revision field overwrites the revision counter.
decoys.reason: revision is set after the change is spread, so a change cannot overwrite it.
